additional_info.subject: ID0432888-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RD 170003082] Surge Protection Error CRM:02919000010
additional_info.body:
Hi Konrad, good morning.
Thanks for the trial. Then I guess the schematics are incorrect with the Surge Protection value.
Then this is a hardware issue now, since we tested the SW solution. For now, we need to check on-site what is wrong with this whole line.
First, check the fuses have continuity - FC1
Second, check if the 24V are reaching the KF5. Usually it can be this XD9.1 which is often loose from inside or outside.
Third, if all these above checks out, please check if the KF5 has any sort of bended pin.
What do you have as spare parts? I would recommend taking a spare FA1, FC1 and, worst case scenario, KF5.
Let me know what is best for you. I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
